messages:
incidents-bot: [PAGER] P1 - inference-latency spike for service 'redwood-runtime' detected in us-west-2. Average token latency 2.7s > SLO. Paging oncall.
Samir: on it — I'll be primary for the next 2h. Taking bridge. @Jordan P secondary unless someone else volunteers.
Jordan P: copy, I'll be secondary and monitor logs/metrics. If it escalates past 10m, I'll take over comms.
Alex K: FYI I'm finishing a deploy in eu-west, no capacity to join bridge until ~20:15. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Samir: noted. Alex, if deploy finishes early ping here. There's a small coverage gap 20:05-20:15 where only primary+secondary are on.
Maria L: I can cover comms if you need a dedicated comms owner. Happy to take customer updates and PagerDuty notes.
Samir: Thanks Maria — can you be comms owner for the next 60m? You'll handle status updates and Slack incident channel.
Maria L: yes, taking comms. I'll post an initial status update in #incidents and pings to the customer contacts doc.
incidents-bot: Bridge created: https://redwood/bridge/incident/1792003456. Runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/inference-latency
Samir: Quick triage notes: spike started ~20:03 coincident with a job that increased long-context requests. KV-cache miss rate up. Metrics: CPU 92% on inference pool nodes.
Jordan P: Kicking off root-cause probes. Checking candidate regressions: model variant change? quantization rollout? also checking autoscaling logs.
Samir: Actions:
- Jordan: check autoscaler events + recent config changes
- Alex: if deploy completes, validate any canary in eu-west
- Maria: post status every 10m to customers and record messages
- Samir: I'll try rolling route traffic to smaller model variant (v1-small) as fallback
Maria L: I'll use the template below when posting updates:
```
Status: Investigating
Impact: Increased inference latency affecting a subset of requests in us-west-2
Next update: +10m or on progress
Owner: Maria L (comms)
```
Jordan P: autoscaler logs show a burst of 8k simultaneous requests at 20:02; scaling requested but not enough nodes came up due to a provisioning throttling error.
Samir: Good catch. Putting a temporary mitigation: scaling cap override + immediate node spin-up, and divert 20% traffic to v1-small. Command:
```
redwood-cli scale --pool inference-usw2 --override 12
redwood-cli route --service redwood-runtime --to-model v1-small --percent 20
```
Alex K: deploy finished; joining bridge. Confirmed no model variant change recently from CI. Will watch node provisioning logs.
Maria L: posted initial customer message in #customers-facing and added PagerDuty note. Next update in 10m.
Samir: handover plan at 20:30: If latency trending down and autoscaler stable, Jordan will resume secondary-only and I step off. If persistent, we'll extend overlap. Comms: Maria remains owner until we declare resolved.
Jordan P: acknowledged. I'll own the next verification and collect golden prompts to check quality after model diversion.
Maria L: will keep logs of customer reactions in runbook template. If any exec escalation, ping @eng-leads.
incidents-bot: Reminder: please fill incident timeline in the postmortem doc: https://redwood/pm/incident-1792003456
Samir: thanks everyone — I'll update this thread when I hand over or if anything critical changes. :white_check_mark:
